name: Amp Orbs
desc: Remote machines where Amp agents keep running without supervision.
desc_zh: 让 Amp 智能体无人值守持续运行的远程机器。
solves: An agent stops when the laptop closes; an orb keeps the session alive and reports back when the work is done.
solves_zh: 笔记本一合上智能体就停；orb 让会话继续活着，干完了再回来汇报。
best_for: You start a long refactor and want it finished by morning without leaving a machine on.
best_for_zh: 开了一个大重构，想让它天亮前跑完，又不想让哪台机器一直开着。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ampcode.com/chronicle news feed）。 Self-hosted orbs followed on 2026-10-22. Separate surface from the Amp CLI already in the ledger. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Orbs」，加上产品名以便辨认。发布时是 Amp 提供的远程机器（自托管版本三个月后才到），不是自己部署的软件。 首次公开日期来源：https://ampcode.com/news/agents-in-orbs
